source_snapshot.procedure: Cable easy to plug/unplug; device redetects without error after plug cycle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY with BF3 endpoint/service-state and host+DPU recovery evidence.

old_problem: BF3/DPU cable/endpoints/sideband map, vendor service state, seating criteria and host/DPU/management/network recovery oracle were absent; generic device presence could miss a failed plane.
disposition_reason: The source does not require hot removal. A conservative vendor-powered-down/discharged path plus qualified operator satisfies ED-09 safely. Identity, latch procedure and expected host/DPU link values are normal runtime prerequisites under ED-03, so review Pending is unnecessary.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2270 and 2271, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve BF3 cable plug cycle, proper physical seating and error-free redetection.
Quiesce both host and DPU traffic, use full vendor-approved powered-down/discharged service and forbid hot removal unless separately proven.
Bind BF3/DPU, cable PN/serial, endpoints/ports and power/sideband functions; inspect latch, pins, shell, routing and bend radius.
After boot/settle compare PCIe/DPU identity, management and representor interfaces, network link/rate and counters/logs to baseline across every plane.
No workload drain, power action, cable handling, boot or DUT query occurred.

test_case.test_name: Powered-down BF3 cable reseat and host/DPU-plane recovery
test_case.purpose: Verify one exact BlueField-3 cable assembly can be safely removed/reseated without damage and that host PCIe, DPU management/representor and network paths all recover correctly.
required_package: BF3/DPU and cable PN/serial endpoint/port/sideband map
Seating/damage/routing criteria, one cycle and settle timeout
Host PCIe, DPU services/interfaces, network link and error oracle
test_case.test_command: Quiesce host/DPU traffic, record all-plane baseline, power down/discharge per vendor procedure; a qualified ESD operator performs one mapped cable remove/reinsert cycle with before/after photos and latch inspection; restore power and collect host PCIe, DPU management/representor/network/link/counter/log evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The correct connector is fully latched/seated with no damage or routing violation, and after readiness every expected host/DPU/management/network identity and negotiated link returns to its approved state with no new disallowed errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires physical evidence plus complete host and DPU-plane recovery. Missing runtime map/procedure blocks execution only. Damage, incomplete latch, missing service/interface/link, degraded rate or new errors is FAIL.
safety_gate: Qualified ESD operator; vendor powered-down/discharged service only.
No unapproved hot removal or auxiliary-power/sideband disruption.
One cycle; stop on resistance, damage or mapping uncertainty.
No repeated reseat to force recovery; preserve logs.
test_case.recovery: On damage or incomplete recovery, keep the platform in the approved safe state, preserve all-plane evidence and follow the spare/rollback procedure; do not repeat or hot-service the cable.
